description: Change the canvas size (Image > Canvas Size) in pixels, keeping the image anchored at a side or corner. New areas take the Canvas Extension Color on a background layer (the background colour unless extensionColor is given) and stay transparent elsewhere

extensionColor.description: Canvas Extension Color for new areas of a background layer. Default: the background colour

height.description: Pixels (added to the current height when relative)

relative.description: Width and height are added to the current size. Default false

width.description: Pixels (added to the current width when relative)

name: resize_canvas
title: Resize Canvas
